item.title: CVE-2025-52474: SQL Injection Vulnerability in id Parameter on control.php Endpoint
item.description:
⚠ Replicated advisory. This post reproduces an advisory originally researched and published under the CVE Hunters. It is republished here for reference. The original disclosure followed coordinated vulnerability disclosure and the rules of the CVE Program.

🔗 Original advisory: https://www.cvehunters.com/p/cve-2025-52474/
📋 CVE record: CVE-2025-52474

CVE Publication: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-52474

Summary

A SQL Injection vulnerability was identified in the id parameter of the /WeGIA/controle/control.php endpoint. This vulnerability allows attacker to manipulate SQL queries and access sensitive database information, such as table names and sensitive data.

item.title: CVE-2025-30366: Multiples Stored XSS in personalizacao.php
item.description:
⚠ Replicated advisory. This post reproduces an advisory originally researched and published under the CVE Hunters. It is republished here for reference. The original disclosure followed coordinated vulnerability disclosure and the rules of the CVE Program.

🔗 Original advisory: https://www.cvehunters.com/p/cve-2025-30366/
📋 CVE record: CVE-2025-30366

CVE Publication: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-30366

Summary

Multiples stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability was identified in the WeGIA application. This vulnerability allows unauthorized scripts to be executed within the user's browser context. Stored XSS is particularly critical, as the malicious code is permanently stored on the server and executed whenever a compromised page is loaded, affecting all users accessing this page.

item.title: CVE-2025-30367: SQL Injection endpoint control.php parameter nextPage
item.description:
⚠ Replicated advisory. This post reproduces an advisory originally researched and published under the CVE Hunters. It is republished here for reference. The original disclosure followed coordinated vulnerability disclosure and the rules of the CVE Program.

🔗 Original advisory: https://www.cvehunters.com/p/cve-2025-30367/
📋 CVE record: CVE-2025-30367

CVE Publication: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-30367

Summary

A SQL Injection vulnerability was identified in the WeGIA application, specifically in the control.php endpoint. This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands in the database, allowing unauthorized access to sensitive information. During the exploit, it was possible to perform a complete dump of the application's database, highlighting the severity of the flaw.
